main_body: Flat grass ground patch (4x3 tiles) with a repeating motif of light-green flower and clump clusters on a mid-green base. It is a terrain tile, not a standing object.
top_band: none: a flat ground surface seen from above, with no standing volume
evidence: Ground terrain has no top-and-front structure to judge. It is a plain top-down ground texture with no receding side faces and no object volume, so the 3/4 contract does not apply and nothing in it contradicts the contract.

style.evidence: The ramp has about 4 greens: base, a lighter highlight, a darker speck and a pale patch. Most of each tile is one flat base green, with large open areas of 5x5 pixels or more. The same small motif repeats identically in a visible grid, so it reads as a stamped pattern. The Beodeul grass reference has more tonal variation and tufts spread across each tile. Each candidate tile carries only about 3-4 colours, well below the reference's roughly 10, so it looks thinner and flatter next to it.
